node.statement: O is nonempty if and only if t*(u)>0. First, t>=0 because the zero exposer is primal feasible. If t=0, the zero exposer is primal optimal, so no upper-box constraint h(p_i)<=1 is tight on the whole primal optimal face and O is empty. Conversely, if t>0, lem-hiddenness-dual-witness gives an optimal witness with sum_i beta_i=t>0; hence supp(beta) is nonempty, and node 1.4 puts that support inside O.
